Threading Building Blocks 2.1, release tbb21_20080605oss (interface version 3011), headers only.

This is the release the 2013 clients ship: bin/player/tbb.dll says "TBB: VERSION 2.1",
"TBB: INTERFACE VERSION 3011", "BUILD_DATE Thu, 5 Jun 2008 08:04:14 UTC", FileVersion 2.1.2008.0605.

Only include/tbb/ (unmodified), COPYING and README are kept here.
License: GPL v2 with the runtime exception (see COPYING and the header comments).

Why 2.1 and not the 4.4 headers in _downloads: TBB 2.1's spin_mutex::scoped_lock keeps the byte
__TBB_LockByte returned (uintptr my_unlock_value) and stores it back on unlock; 4.4 stores 0.
PLAYER Body::getPV_Spin_Lock 0x007554e0 (`mov ebx,eax` after `call __TBB_LockByte`, then `mov [esi],bl`).
